name: Pebble Merge
description: A sliding merge puzzle on a 4 by 4 river tray. Slide the pebbles, join two of a size into the next size, and see how large a stone you can make. A tray each day, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A 4 by 4 tray of river pebbles. Every slide moves all the pebbles one way, and a new small pebble rolls in. Pebbles come in eleven sizes, from Grain up to Peak.
help.goal: Join pebbles to make a larger one than before. There is no score to chase and nothing to lose. When no slide is left the tray is full, and you can start a new tray.
howToPlay: Press an arrow key to slide every pebble that way until it meets the edge or another pebble.
When two pebbles of the same size meet, they join into the next size up. Each pair joins once per slide.
After each slide that moves something, one new small pebble arrives in an empty spot.
Undo takes back your last slide, one step only. Today's tray is the same for everyone today and remembers the largest pebble you made. New tray deals a fresh one.

controls.action: Slide all the pebbles that way
Slide, when using a touch screen or pointer
Reach Undo, Today's tray and New tray

tips: Keep your largest pebble in a corner and build next to it.
Try to use only two or three directions most of the time.
A slide that moves nothing does not count, so you cannot waste one.
You can stop at any time. Your tray is saved and waits for you.
